# ICU4X Data Patches (`ICU4X-json`)

This directory contains unified `.patch` files applied by
`//tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py` (`//tools/crates/icu4x_datagen`) to
upstream `ICU4X-json` payloads generated by `icu_provider_source` before baking
the Rust data tables into `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data/src/data/`.

`icu4x_datagen` discovers default patches via the `patches = [...]` list in
`//tools/crates/icu4x_datagen/config.toml` (additional patches can also be
passed on the command line via `--patches`). Each patch in this directory is a
standard `diff -ruN a/ b/` unified diff whose paths are relative to the
`ICU4X-json` root (`<marker_path>/[<marker_attributes>/]<locale>.json` or
`<marker_path>.json` for singletons).

## Patch Files in This Directory

- `name_5_langs.patch`
  - **Source / Upstream Equivalent**:
    `//third_party/icu/patches/name_5_langs.patch` +
    `//third_party/icu/source/data/lang/{an,wa}.txt`
  - **Affected `ICU4X-json` Markers**:
    `locale/names/language/medium/tiny/v1/<lang>/<lang>.json`,
    `locale/names/language/v0/<lang>.json`
  - **Description**: Adds native language autonyms for Chromium's non-UI
    Accept-Languages that are missing from upstream CLDR 49: `an` (`aragonés`),
    `ay` (`Aymar`), `dv` (`ދިވެހި`), `ilo` (`Ilokano`), `lus` (`Mizo tawng`),
    `ts` (`Xitsonga`), and `wa` (`Walon`, fixing a historical copy-paste typo
    in ICU4C's `source/data/lang/wa.txt` where `Walon` was keyed under `ku`).
    All 11 `icu::locale::names::LanguageIdentifierDisplayName` constructors
    fall back to `LocaleNamesLanguageMediumTinyV1`. `LocaleNamesLanguageV0`
    (`icu_experimental::displaynames`) is also patched for completeness (in
    filtered Chromium builds with `abridge_non_ui_locales = true`,
    non-attributed `v0` maps are restricted to UI locales, whereas
    `--unfiltered` builds include `v0` for all locales). The other two
    preserved files in `source/data/lang/{ku,tg}.txt` (`ku` and `tg`) are
    already populated in upstream CLDR 49.
- `locale1.patch`
  - **Source / Upstream Equivalent**: `//third_party/icu/patches/locale1.patch`
  - **Affected `ICU4X-json` Markers**:
    `datetime/patterns/range/date/gregorian/v1/ym0d/{ko,ko-CN,ko-KP}.json`,
    `timezone/names/generic/long/v1/{ko,ko-CN,ko-KP}.json`,
    `timezone/names/specific/long/v1/{ko,ko-CN,ko-KP}.json`
  - **Description**:
    1. Overrides Korean (`ko`, `ko-CN`, `ko-KP`) Gregorian `yMMMd` day-interval
       spacing (`y년 M월 d일~d일` -> `y년 M월 d일 ~ d일`). Note that ICU4C's
       `yMMM` `M` interval hunk (`y년 M월~M월` -> `y년 M월 ~ M월`) does not
       affect `icu_provider_source` output because `ko` Gregorian
       `dateSkeletons` use `yMMMMd` (`Long`) and `yMd`/`yyMd`
       (`Medium`/`Short`), so `ym0` selects `yMMMM` and `yM` rather than
       `yMMM`.
    2. Overrides Korean (`ko`, `ko-CN`, `ko-KP`) North American metazone long
       names (`America_Central` -> `북미 중부 ...`, `America_Eastern` ->
       `북미 동부 ...`, `America_Mountain` -> `북미 로키 산맥 ...`, and
       `America_Pacific` -> `북미 태평양 ...`). Note that `timezone/` is not
       yet in `CHROMIUM_MARKER_PREFIXES` (`icu_time` is not yet vendored in
       `//third_party/rust`), so the `timezone/` hunks will take effect in
       baked data once `icu_time` is added, whereas the `datetime/` range hunks
       are active now.

- `google3-overlay.patch`
  - **Source / Upstream Equivalent**: `google3`
    `//third_party/icu4x_data/overlay:export_overlay` /
    `//third_party/icu/google/patches/cldr/`
  - **Affected `ICU4X-json` Markers**: `currency/fractions/v1.json`
  - **Description**: Applies `google3`'s CLDR currency fraction patch
    `gh-00002-rsd_decimal_digits.patch` (`RSD` digits `2` -> `0`). Note that
    `google3`'s region display-name alt-variant overrides (`FK`, `HK`, `MO`,
    `PS`) live in ICU4C's `cldr-to-icu` converter configuration rather than raw
    CLDR data, and are being added to ICU4X datagen (`AltVariantKind`) in
    https://github.com/unicode-org/icu4x/pull/8640 (see
    [`chromium-data.patch` Subpatches](#chromium-datapatch-subpatches)).

## Audit of `//third_party/icu/patches/`

Below is the complete audit of all 25 patch files in
`//third_party/icu/patches/` (along with the local modifications documented in
sections C and D of `//third_party/icu/README.chromium`), showing either the
corresponding `ICU4X-json` patch or why the patch is removed for ICU4X:

### 1. Locale / CLDR Data Patches (6)

- `chromium-data.patch` — **Ported via `google3-overlay.patch` (and ICU4X
  `AltVariantKind`)**: Google's internal CLDR/ICU locale overlay exported for
  Chromium (`README.chromium` D.1). Carried in `google3-overlay.patch` (see the
  dedicated [`chromium-data.patch` Subpatches](#chromium-datapatch-subpatches)
  section below).
- `name_5_langs.patch` — **Ported (`name_5_langs.patch`)**: Native autonyms for
  `ay`, `dv`, `ilo`, `lus`, and `ts` (`README.chromium` D.1), combined with `an`
  and `wa` from preserved `source/data/lang/{an,ku,tg,wa}.txt`
  (`README.chromium` C.3; `ku` and `tg` are now in upstream CLDR 49).
- `locale1.patch` — **Ported (`locale1.patch`)**: Korean (`ko`) Gregorian
  `yMMMd` day-interval spacing and North American metazone long names
  (`README.chromium` D.1).
- `ampmmarkers.patch` — **Removed (legacy ICU 78 workaround)**: Rewrites
  `AmPmMarkers` to `AmPmMarkersAbbr` across 18 locales (`ICU-23332`,
  `README.chromium` D.11). Neither `google3` nor Firefox carries this patch, and
  `README.chromium` notes Chromium plans to drop it for cross-browser
  interoperability.
- `cldr-hv-en-root.diff` — **Removed (upstreamed in CLDR 49)**: Reverted ICU
  78's `Hv{"HH'h' v"}` to `Hv{"HH v"}` in `en.txt` (`unicode-org/cldr#5309`,
  `README.chromium` D.12); already fixed upstream in CLDR 49.
- `missing_iso8601_resource.patch` — **Removed (upstreamed in CLDR 49 & N/A)**:
  Backported `iso8601` `eras` in `supplementalData.txt` (`ICU-23262`,
  `README.chromium` D.13); fixed upstream in CLDR 49, and ICU4X
  `icu_calendar::Iso` does not read `supplementalData` era tables.

*(Note: `README.chromium` D.3 also deletes `Factory{"Etc/Unknown"}` from
`timezoneTypes.txt` via `scripts/update_tz.sh` (`crbug.com/381620359`); ICU4X's
IANA TZDB parser already maps `Factory` and unknown zones to `"unk"` /
`TimeZone::UNKNOWN` without a patch.)*

### 2. Segmenter / Break Iterator Patches (5)

- `line_normal.patch` — **Removed (configured via API)**: Changes `line` to
  `line_normal.brk` in `source/data/brkitr/root.txt` (`README.chromium` D.2).
  In ICU4X `icu_segmenter`, CSS line-break strictness is passed directly via
  `LineBreakOptions` (`LineBreakStrictness::Normal`).
- `lstm.patch` — **Removed (configured via filter & API)**: Removes Thai and
  Burmese from the `lstm` block in `source/data/brkitr/root.txt`
  (`README.chromium` D.2). In ICU4X `icu_segmenter`, dictionary vs. LSTM models
  are selected via segmenter options and per-platform `brkitr_dictionaries`
  filtering in `//third_party/icu/filters/*.json`.
- `wordbrk.patch` — **Removed (N/A to `ICU4X-json` CLDR patches)**: Moves full
  stops (`U+002E`, `U+FF0E`) from `MidNumLet` to `MidNum` and removes `:` from
  `MidLetter` in ICU4C RBBI `rules/word.txt` and `word_POSIX.txt`
  (`README.chromium` D.2). ICU4X `icu_segmenter` uses precompiled UAX #29
  property/state tables from `icuexportdata` (`segmenter/break/word/*`) rather
  than ICU4C `.txt` RBBI rules (and `icu_segmenter` is not yet in
  `CHROMIUM_MARKER_PREFIXES`).
- `cjdict.patch` — **Removed (N/A to `ICU4X-json` CLDR patches)**: Adds 7
  Chinese words to `source/data/brkitr/dictionaries/cjdict.txt` (`ICU-10888`,
  `README.chromium` D.2). `icu_provider_source` loads precompiled segmenter
  dictionaries from `icuexportdata` rather than `cjdict.txt` (and
  `icu_segmenter` is not yet in `CHROMIUM_MARKER_PREFIXES`).
- `khmer-dictbe.patch` — **Removed (ICU4C C++ code only)**: Adjusts C++
  dictionary break engine constants in `source/common/dictbe.cpp` (`ICU-9451`,
  `README.chromium` D.2) to match Chromium's abridged `khmerdict.txt`; modifies
  no data files.

### 3. Legacy Encoding Conversion Table Patches (1)

- `gb_table.patch` — **Removed (N/A — legacy `.ucm` charset conversion)**:
  Record-only patch (`README.chromium` C.1) for `gb18030.ucm` and
  `windows-936-2000.ucm`. ICU4X does not provide legacy codepage converters
  (Chromium uses Blink codecs / `encoding_rs`).

### 4. ICU4C C/C++ Code, Header, & Build Patches (13)

The remaining 13 files in `//third_party/icu/patches/` only modify ICU4C C/C++
source code, headers, or build scripts and have no data component (so all 13
are removed for ICU4X):

- `configure.patch` — Removes a `source/configure` check (`README.chromium`
  D.4).
- `data_symb.patch` — Adds `ICU_DATA_ENTRY_POINT` in `utypes.h`
  (`README.chromium` D.4).
- `iso2022jp.patch` — Patches `ucnv2022.cpp` for WHATWG ISO-2022-JP
  (`ICU-20251`, `README.chromium` D.5).
- `restrace.patch` — Patches `uresbund.cpp` file/resource tracing
  (`README.chromium` D.6).
- `fuchsia.patch` — Patches `uposixdefs.h` for Fuchsia builds on macOS
  (`README.chromium` D.7).
- `revert_realpath.patch` — Patches `putil.cpp` timezone detection on macOS 14
  (`ICU-22541`, `README.chromium` D.8).
- `pkgdata_string_storage.patch` — Increases buffer size in `pkgdata.cpp`
  (`ICU-23276`, `README.chromium` D.9).
- `charstr.patch` — Fixes signed `int32_t` overflow in `charstr.cpp`
  (`ICU-23537`, `README.chromium` D.14).
- `reordering_buffer_overflow.patch` — Fixes `int32_t` overflow in
  `normalizer2impl.{h,cpp}` (`ICU-23490`, `README.chromium` D.15).
- `number_max_digits.patch` — Caps maximum formatted digits in
  `number_formatimpl.cpp` (`ICU-23144`, `README.chromium` D.16).
- `numrange_impl.patch` — Returns early on failure in `numrange_impl.cpp`
  (`ICU-23539`, `README.chromium` D.17).
- `usearch_ceibuffer_64bit.patch` — Uses 64-bit CE indexes in `usearch.cpp`
  (`ICU-23568`, `README.chromium` D.18).
- `collation_fcd_tccc.patch` — Fixes backward FCD check in
  `utf16collationiterator.cpp` (`ICU-23569`, `README.chromium` D.19).

*(Note: `cast_implicit_conversion.patch` is still mentioned in
`README.chromium` D.10, but the patch file itself has already been deleted from
`//third_party/icu/patches/`.)*

## `chromium-data.patch` Subpatches

`//third_party/icu/patches/chromium-data.patch` (exported from `google3` by
`step5_pub_to_google3.py`) bundles several `google3` CLDR XML patches and
ICU4C `cldr-to-icu` converter rules into a single diff. For ICU4X, the CLDR
data overlay will live in **`google3-overlay.patch`** (exported from `google3`
via `//third_party/icu4x_data/overlay:export_overlay`), while `cldr-to-icu`
alt-variant overrides are being added to ICU4X datagen upstream:

1. **Pseudolocales `en_XA` and `ar_XB` (~69.8% of `chromium-data.patch`,
   ~20,010 lines) — Does not matter (removed)**: Generated as a byproduct of
   `google3`'s `cldr-staging` build; immediately deleted by Chromium's
   `make_data_all.sh` and absent from all 8 `icudtl.dat` bundles.
2. **Territory display-name `<altPath>` overrides (~29.7%, ~8,512 lines) —
   Matters (handled via ICU4X `AltVariantKind` / `google3-overlay.patch`)**:
   Comes from `google3`'s `g3-icu_tools_cldr_cldr-to-icu_config.xml.patch`,
   selecting alt variants for region display names: `FK` -> `alt="variant"`
   (`Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas)`), `HK` -> `alt="short"` (`Hong Kong`),
   `MO` -> `alt="short"` (`Macao`), and `PS` -> `alt="short"` (`Palestine`).
   Because `google3` applies these `<altPath>` rules inside ICU4C's
   `cldr-to-icu` converter (`config.xml`) when producing ICU4C data rather than
   patching raw CLDR XML/JSON, `google3`'s `SourceDataProvider::new_google3()`
   (and thus `export_overlay`) only sees patched CLDR data and cannot inspect
   ICU4C converter output. Upstream PR
   https://github.com/unicode-org/icu4x/pull/8640 adds native `AltVariantKind`
   support (`LocaleNamesFkVariant`, `LocaleNamesHkShort`, `LocaleNamesMoShort`,
   `LocaleNamesPsShort`) to `icu_provider_source` so ICU4X datagen (and
   `google3-overlay.patch` if needed) can apply these alt variants directly.
3. **Currency decimal digits (`gh-00002-rsd_decimal_digits.patch` and
   `gh-00050-cldr_pkr_decimal_digits.patch`) — `RSD` matters (in
   `google3-overlay.patch`), `PKR` already upstream**: `gh-00002` changes `RSD`
   `digits` `2` -> `0` (`currency/fractions/v1.json`, carried in
   `google3-overlay.patch`). `gh-00050` (`PKR` `digits` `0` -> `2`,
   `CLDR-19663`) is already upstream in CLDR 49.
4. **Gregorian average duration units
   (`g3-00024-cldr_common_supplemental_units.xml.patch`, ~63 lines) — Does not
   matter for ECMA-402 `Intl` (ICU4C/google3 internal units)**: Adds
   `month-average-gregory`, `quarter-average-gregory`, `year-average-gregory`,
   `decade-average-gregory`, and `century-average-gregory` to
   `supplemental/units.xml` (will appear in `google3-overlay.patch` if
   `icu_experimental` units markers are enabled in `google3`'s
   `export_overlay`).
5. **`UAH` currency symbol `alt="variant"` (`₴` -> `грн.` in `ru` and `uk`,
   ~56 lines) — Does not matter (legacy workaround dropped)**: Vestigial 2008
   CLDR 1.6 font-glyph workaround in `cldr-to-icu` (`config.xml`);
   intentionally dropped in https://github.com/unicode-org/icu4x/pull/8640.
6. **`ar` `defaultNumberingSystem` `alt="latn"` (~11 lines) — Does not matter
   (already upstream)**: Upstream CLDR `ar.xml` already defaults `ar` to
   `"latn"` (`ar-EG` remains `"arab"`).
7. **CLDR 48 TZDB / metazone cherry-picks (`gh-00003`, `gh-0101`, `gh-0102`,
   `gh-0103`) and `g3-00001.temp_fix_48.patch` — Do not matter (already
   upstream in CLDR 49 / TZDB)**.

## Creating or Updating a Patch

1. Dump the unpatched `ICU4X-json` files for the markers and locales you want
   to inspect:
   ```sh
   python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py dump-json \
     --json-dir /tmp/icu4x_json/a \
     --markers locale/names/language/ datetime/patterns/range/ timezone/names/ \
     --locales ko ko-CN ko-KP wa
   ```
2. Copy `/tmp/icu4x_json/a` to `/tmp/icu4x_json/b`, edit the JSON files under
   `/tmp/icu4x_json/b`, and generate a unified diff:
   ```sh
   cp -r /tmp/icu4x_json/a /tmp/icu4x_json/b
   # Edit files under /tmp/icu4x_json/b/...
   (cd /tmp/icu4x_json && diff -ruN a b) \
     > third_party/rust/icu4x_data/patches/my_patch.patch
   ```
3. Register the patch in `//tools/crates/icu4x_datagen/config.toml` under
   `patches = [...]` and regenerate `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data/src/data/`.
---

## Generating `google3-overlay.patch` from `google3`

`google3-overlay.patch` captures `ICU4X-json` payload differences introduced by
`google3`'s CLDR patches (`//third_party/icu/google/patches/cldr/`) relative to
upstream CLDR. Because `//third_party/icu4x_data/overlay:export_overlay` diffs
`SourceDataProvider::new_google3()` against unpatched CLDR, it captures CLDR
XML/JSON patches directly; `google3` overrides configured inside ICU4C's
`cldr-to-icu` converter (`g3-icu_tools_cldr_cldr-to-icu_config.xml.patch`
`<altPath>` rules for `FK`, `HK`, `MO`, and `PS`) are handled via ICU4X
`AltVariantKind` options (https://github.com/unicode-org/icu4x/pull/8640).

To regenerate `google3-overlay.patch` using the `google3` overlay exporter tool
(`//third_party/icu4x_data/overlay:export_overlay`):

1. In a `google3` workspace, run
   `//third_party/icu4x_data/overlay:export_overlay` to export the `ICU4X-json`
   files that differ between `SourceDataProvider::new_google3()` and upstream
   CLDR:
   ```sh
   blaze run --//i18n/icu4x:build_without_baked_data=true \
     //third_party/icu4x_data/overlay:export_overlay -- \
     --out /tmp/google3_icu4x_overlay/b
   ```
2. In your Chromium `src/` checkout, dump the corresponding unpatched
   `ICU4X-json` files into `/tmp/google3_icu4x_overlay/a` (for each marker
   exported into `/tmp/google3_icu4x_overlay/b`, e.g. `currency/fractions/v1`):
   ```sh
   python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py dump-json \
     --json-dir /tmp/google3_icu4x_overlay/a \
     --markers currency/fractions/v1
   ```
3. Remove any `.checksum` files and empty marker directories, then produce the
   unified diff:
   ```sh
   find /tmp/google3_icu4x_overlay -name '*.checksum' -delete
   find /tmp/google3_icu4x_overlay/b -type d -empty -delete
   (cd /tmp/google3_icu4x_overlay && diff -ruN a b) \
     > third_party/rust/icu4x_data/patches/google3-overlay.patch
   ```
